items.stem: Which task is the best candidate for subagent delegation?

options.text: Investigating three independent modules that do not share state
options.rationale: Correct: independent work parallelises cleanly with little coordination cost.

options.text: Designing one shared interface every module must agree on
options.rationale: A single coupled decision is better kept in one place.

options.text: Renaming one variable in one file
options.rationale: Trivial inline work gains nothing from delegation.

options.text: A task whose steps each depend on the previous result
options.rationale: Strictly sequential work cannot be parallelised usefully.

items.explanation: Correct: independent work parallelises cleanly with little coordination cost.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO belong in a well-scoped subagent brief? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The specific inputs the subagent should work from
options.rationale: Correct: clear inputs keep the subagent on the intended material.

options.text: A definition of the report the subagent must return
options.rationale: Correct: a defined output makes results combinable.

options.text: An instruction to do whatever it thinks best with no bounds
options.rationale: Unbounded scope produces results that are hard to combine.

options.text: The parent's entire unrelated conversation history
options.rationale: Irrelevant context adds noise and overhead.

items.explanation: Correct: clear inputs keep the subagent on the intended material.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Two subagents return proposals with incompatible interfaces. The right action is to:

options.text: Reconcile them into one coherent decision before proceeding
options.rationale: Correct: conflicts must be resolved so the combined result is consistent.

options.text: Merge both as-is and let callers pick
options.rationale: Shipping contradictory interfaces pushes the conflict downstream.

options.text: Discard both reports and start over
options.rationale: The investigations have value; reconcile rather than discard.
Length is not a basis for resolving a design conflict.

items.explanation: Correct: conflicts must be resolved so the combined result is consistent.
